A '''hygiene kit''' was a personal grooming kit. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents who infiltrated [[Training Camp IMIIF-138]] on [[Sirpar/Legends|Sirpar]] were issued with hygiene kits that had a hidden burst [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] that allowed them to call for extraction.
